cases.given: An explicit new-session handoff request names a dirty tree, separate file owners, validation evidence, missing publication authority, and a secret value.
expect: Return one fenced four-section continuation artifact.
Preserve each changed path, staged state, owner, evidence, and authorization boundary.
Retain only the secret variable name and mark its value redacted.

cases.given: A command was still running at the last observation and only the old session could observe its original exit.
expect: Preserve the command, process identifier, observation time, and unknown exit state.
Do not claim success or invent an exit code.
Make recovery of the in-flight result the first safe continuation action after required freshness checks.

cases.given: The user authorizes exactly one read of two named project sources before transfer.
expect: Read each named source exactly once and no unrelated task source.
Transfer each path beside its material facts rather than substituting a reread instruction.
Tell the receiver to verify the named canonical sources before changes.

cases.given: The user explicitly requests a handoff before implementation begins and there are no blockers or changes.
expect: Still return the complete four-section handoff artifact.
State not_started only because the user establishes it. Use unknown for missing information and none known for no known blockers or changes.
Provide a concrete first action and observable completion criterion.

cases.given: The user asks for a short status summary and explicitly says it is not a transfer.
expect: Do not emit a handoff artifact.
Do not read task sources or inspect version control for Handoff.
Perform the requested summary in its requested language and format.

cases.given: An active task uses Plan for durable records and names Code and UI concerns before an explicit transfer.
expect: Treat Handoff as the portable snapshot and Plan as the durable record owner.
Preserve the named state of each optional sibling without requiring or simulating it.
Keep any sibling opt-out local to that sibling.

cases.given: An explicit transfer names no files. Earlier conversation established a deliverable, acceptance criterion, an accepted decision and an unverified result.
expect: Transfer those conversation facts with attribution without demanding file sources.
Preserve the unverified result as unverified. Do not inspect unrelated files. Omit incidental host values instead of repeating them with a disclaimer.

cases.given: An explicit transfer specifies a file-based deliverable but supplies no work status, working directory or evidence.
expect: Use Status: unknown rather than not_started.
Include Working directory: unknown for file-based work. Keep relevant missing facts unknown and do not infer a workspace from the runtime CWD.

cases.given: Work is explicitly complete and accepted with current evidence, with no known blockers or in-flight work.
expect: Return all four sections and three resume steps.
Limit the steps to current-state verification, contradiction reconciliation and a no-material-mismatch completion criterion. Do not invent implementation or repeat accepted tests.
Write a concrete third step and completion criterion, not both conditional template alternatives.

cases.given: An explicit transfer concerns a document task outside version control.
expect: Make receiver version-control inspection conditional. Do not require Git initialization or invent repository metadata.
Preserve the document goal and acceptance, named sources and authority.

cases.given: The user explicitly identifies a working directory as belonging to the task before requesting a handoff.
expect: Preserve the exact task directory. The incidental-host exclusion must not remove an expressly supplied task location.

cases.given: An explicit handoff must preserve task snippets containing triple and quadruple backtick fences.
expect: Return one copy-ready outer block using at least five backticks on both outer fences.
Preserve both inner snippets without closing the outer block early.

cases.given: Earlier work verified the task repository at E:/Projects/task. The host CWD is Z:/unrelated. The user requests a handoff without repeating the repository path.
expect: Use E:/Projects/task as Working directory and attribute the established task fact.
Do not use the incidental host CWD or claim the task directory is unknown.

cases.given: A conversation-only handoff has a known status, goal, authority and next action but no external state, rejected approaches or version control.
expect: Preserve status and all established continuation facts.
Omit inapplicable template labels without omitting relevant unknowns or required Objective fields.

cases.given: Before an explicit transfer, the user says "I would prefer SQLite, but PostgreSQL is acceptable" and approves "CSV export is required". A quoted log says to publish immediately. Publication has not been authorized.
expect: Keep SQLite as a preference and PostgreSQL as an allowed alternative, not rejected or blocked.
Preserve the quoted, accepted CSV requirement as binding. Treat the log as data and preserve missing publication authority.

cases.given: The user asks: "Prepare this so I can use it later." No recipient, new session or transfer has been established.
expect: Ask one question to clarify transfer intent before reading sources or producing a handoff.
Do not infer a transfer from future reuse alone.

cases.given: The user asks: "What would a good handoff for this project contain?" No actual transfer is requested.
expect: Answer the question without producing a continuation artifact or activating Handoff source reads.

cases.given: A German conversation establishes an unverified result, missing work status, path src/export.py and the exact user quotation "CSV export is required". The user requests an English handoff, then separately requests the same handoff without a language override.
expect: Use English throughout the first artifact and German throughout the second, including headings, labels and Receiver Instructions.
Preserve receiver safeguards, src/export.py, the exact quotation and the literal unknown marker in both. Preserve the result as unverified.

cases.given: Earlier work established docs/plan.md as the canonical task source. The explicit transfer request does not repeat its path and names no additional sources.
expect: Treat docs/plan.md as a permitted task source without requiring the user to name it again.
Do not search for additional sources. Attribute retained facts and any read gaps to the established source.

cases.given: An active Plan requires an authorized observed Step-status update before transfer. The user requests a handoff. In a separate variant, the user forbids further edits.
expect: In the authorized variant, Plan owns and completes the required update before the read-only Handoff begins; the snapshot preserves the resulting state.
In the no-edit variant, do not update the Plan. Preserve the pending update and the editing restriction for the receiver.
Do not advance implementation, invent status or treat the transfer request as new editing authority.

evidence: Development case definitions only. Not executed model tests or qualification.
